title: Microsoft Copilot: PowerPoint Agent builds presentations from chat
summary: Hold: the scope section says no default is documented, although Learn describes Microsoft-installed agents appearing for licensed users when Anthropic is enabled and the page itself rates the default as on. The control paths, Graph operation and licensing statements are supported, and the disagreement between Learn and the roadmap is accurately reported.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: Disabling Anthropic prevents access to these agents even for paid Microsoft 365 Copilot users.
claims.quote: If administrators disable Anthropic models, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Agents are unavailable, including for users with a paid Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

claims.claim: Disabling Anthropic can also make other dependent features inaccessible.
claims.quote: Some features are only available when Claude models are enabled. If you turn off Anthropic as a subprocessor, certain features may no longer be accessible.

claims.claim: An agent-store listing can remain visible when Anthropic is disabled and does not establish that Anthropic is enabled.
claims.quote: The Office Agent might still appear in the agent store, but users can't access or use it. Visibility in the agent store doesn't indicate that Anthropic models are enabled for the tenant.

claims.claim: The agents create Word, Excel and PowerPoint files within Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote: These agents use advanced AI models to create Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files within Microsoft Copilot.

claims.claim: The printed Copilot > Settings > User access route reaches Disable Anthropic as a Microsoft subprocessor in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: select Copilot > Settings. On the User access page, select AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors. On the AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors page, under Available subprocessors for your organization, select Disable Anthropic as a Microsoft subprocessor.

claims.claim: Learn documents no automation operation for enabling or disabling the AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors setting.
claims.quote: Searched: AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors Anthropic Microsoft Graph API PowerShell enable disable user group assignment; Microsoft Graph copilot admin settings AI provider Anthropic subprocessor API update assignments. Opened connect-to-ai-subprocessor and provider-access pages.

claims.claim: The printed Copilot > Settings > View all route reaches Choose who can access Anthropic models for Copilot and generative AI experiences.
claims.quote: select Copilot > Settings > View all. Select AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors. under Available subprocessors for your organization, select Anthropic, and Save. Under Choose who can access Anthropic models for Copilot and generative AI experiences, select your users or groups

claims.claim: Learn documents no API or PowerShell operation for assigning users or groups to the Anthropic provider.
claims.quote: Searched: AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors Anthropic Microsoft Graph API PowerShell enable disable user group assignment; Microsoft Graph copilot admin settings AI provider Anthropic subprocessor API update assignments. Opened provider-access and connect-to-ai-subprocessor pages.
